summary: Jessie Woodrow Wilson Sayre (1887–1933) was a daughter of US President Woodrow Wilson and Ellen Louise Axson. She was a political activist who campaigned for women's suffrage and social issues and promoted her father's call for a League of Nations. She also became an influential figure in the Massachusetts Democratic Party.
one_line: Jessie Woodrow Wilson Sayre, daughter of President Woodrow Wilson, was an activist for women's suffrage and the League of Nations and a Massachusetts Democratic force.
